en.bdb: Living in the fear of God, Gurmukhs attain formless God

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਮਣਿ ਨਿਮਿ ਭੈ ਵਿਚ ਜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhai vich niman nim bhai vich jaiaa|

en.bdb: Under the natural law (fear of lord), the jiva (creature) is conceived (by mother) and in the fear (law) he is born.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhai vich gurmukh pa(n)th saranee aaiaa|

en.bdb: In fear he comes in the shelter of the way (panth) of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhai vich sa(n)gat saadh sabadh kamaiaa|

en.bdb: In fear while in the holy congregation he earns the merit of the True Word

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhai vich jeevan mukat bhaanaa bhaiaa|

en.bdb: In fear (natural laws) he gets liberated in life and accepts the will of God happily.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhai vich janam savaar sahaj samaiaa|

en.bdb: In fear he leaves away this life and merges in equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit_en: bhai vich nij ghar jai pooraa paiaa ||20||

en.bdb: In fear he settles in his self and attains the supreme Perfect Being.
